name: Iraq (2004–2008)
description: A horizontal tricolour of red, white and black, the white stripe bearing three green five-pointed stars with the takbir 'Allahu Akbar' in green Kufic script between them.
history: Adopted on 28 July 2004 by the Interim Government as a compromise: the handwritten takbir associated with Saddam Hussein was redrawn in Kufic script. On 22 January 2008 the three stars, associated with Ba'athism, were removed to give the current flag.

features.role: the takbir 'Allahu Akbar' in Kufic script between the stars
